products.title: Apple 13" MacBook Air (M3, Starlight)
products.description: The Apple 13" MacBook Air (Early 2024) in Starlight features the powerful M3 8-core chip with a 10-core GPU and a 16-core Neural Engine, delivering significant performance boosts for creative apps and games. It is equipped with 16GB of unified RAM and a 512GB SSD. The laptop boasts a 13.6" Liquid Retina Display with a resolution of 2560 x 1664, offering vivid colors and sharp detail. Designed for portability, it weighs only 2.73 lbs and is 0.44" thin, featuring a durable 100% recycled aluminum enclosure. Additional features include a backlit Magic Keyboard, Touch ID sensor, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and two Thunderbolt/USB4 ports.

products.title: MacBook Air 13"
products.description: The Apple MacBook Air 13-inch is a high-performance, portable laptop powered by the M5 chip with a 10-core CPU and 8-core GPU. Designed for efficiency and AI workloads, it features 16 GB of unified memory, a 512 GB SSD, and a brilliant 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display supporting one billion colors. This model comes in a sleek Midnight aluminum finish and offers up to 18 hours of battery life, making it ideal for demanding workflows on the go. It includes a 12MP Center Stage camera, a three-mic array, and a four-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio and Dolby Atmos.

products.title: ProDock Solo USB-C Docking Station for MacBook Air 13-Inch M2, M3, M4 & M5
products.description: The Brydge ProDock Solo is an aluminum vertical USB-C docking station designed specifically for MacBooks. It transforms your workspace into a focused single-display setup by holding the laptop upright to save desk space. The dock supports one external display up to 4K at 60Hz and provides up to 90W of power delivery to charge the connected MacBook. It significantly expands connectivity with 3 USB-A ports, 2 USB-C 3.1 ports (up to 10 Gbps), Gigabit Ethernet, an SD 3.0 card reader, and a 3.5mm audio jack. Additionally, it features a 10-watt MagSafe-compatible wireless charging area for compatible iPhones. This plug-and-play device requires no driver installation.
